verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine and model provider, so an assistant-driven model recommendation is a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows adjacent tooling: a `cactus benchmark` command, `needle whistle compare` for speech models, platform requirement lists and llms.txt docs for agents. Nothing documents an AI assistant that recommends a model for the user's hardware and task before download.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
